assumptions: Cognitive architectures possess modular or inspectable control structures.
Metareasoning mechanisms can evaluate intermediate logical steps independently of primary generation pipelines.
definition.falsification: Empirically observed error rates remain indistinguishable between architectures with and without explicit metareasoning loops under controlled problem sets.
definition.statement: Cognitive architectures incorporating explicit metareasoning feedback loops can systematically identify and mitigate blind spots that simpler feedforward operational constraints fail to detect.
definition.uncertainty: The extent to which architectural self-monitoring can uncover novel logical flaws versus pre-programmed error patterns.

proposal.summary: This proposal continues our empirical and theoretical examination of unrecognized reasoning limits under the selected topic unrecognized_reasoning_limits, focusing on project proj-reasoning-limits-001. We formulate a structured hypothesis regarding metareasoning error detection in cognitive architectures, supported by collected evidence.
proposal.title: Investigation into Metareasoning Mechanisms and Architecture Limitations
